name: Pubertymaxxing stack

lead: A pubertymaxxing stack is the name forum members give to a set of compounds, often growth hormone or secretagogues, androgens and supporting supplements, that teenagers say they plan to use to get more height and a more masculine face and body while puberty is still under way.
The goal is a taller, broader, more dimorphic look. Posters usually present stacks as plans and ask others to rate them; no clinical trial has tested such combinations for these goals.

paras: Threads typically list a planned stack by category (height, androgens, supplements) and ask for review. The wiki does not reproduce compounds' doses or sourcing.

Anabolic steroids can accelerate bone maturation and close growth plates early, which may stunt final height; they are controlled substances, and adolescents are a vulnerable group for hormonal disruption.

angle.text: Posters describe stacks as a way to push growth and masculine features during the window in which puberty is still active. Whether the combinations achieve this is untested.

lead: A pubertymaxxing stack is a combination of drugs and supplements that, in the looksmaxxing forum Looksmax.org, users plan to take during adolescence to increase height, masculinise the face and build the body. Stacks are usually posted as proposals for others to critique, and they often combine growth-hormone-related products, androgens and anti-oestrogen or fertility-preserving drugs with long supplement lists [1].

Medical sources note that anabolic steroids can cause premature closure of growth plates and faster bone maturation in adolescents, which may reduce adult height [2]. Growth-plate fusion normally occurs between roughly 14 and 17 in boys, and sex steroids, including oestrogen, drive the process [3].
infobox: Growth hormone or secretagogues, androgens, aromatase inhibitors, supplements [1]

paras: Posters argue that supplying hormones while growth plates are open can add height and strengthen the jaw, brow and shoulders. One thread from a 16-year-old lists a three-part plan covering height, androgens and supplements, and receives replies from other users suggesting additions or removals [1].

Anabolic steroid use in adolescence is associated with premature growth-plate closure, accelerated bone maturation, early sexual development and poorer health attitudes [2]. Steroids are controlled substances in many countries [2]. Rising oestrogen at puberty is the normal signal for plate closure, which is why replies in forum threads sometimes caution about interactions with height [1][3].
